mandatory: Exactly six boxes in one row, left to right in the order listed; boxes 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 soft blue; box 3 light grey with a grey border
Exactly five arrows, each joining one box to the next on its right
Labels are medium-size semibold text, wrap only between words and take at most three lines; the only text in each box is its label
The icon in box 1 is a plain blank card with one stripe; it shows no person, face or avatar
The amber band is above the red band; each holds one line
The title reads exactly 'Step 3: the order the skill requires', bold, top-left, one line, in the same size as a slide title (not oversized)
Every string in text_exact appears exactly once, spelled exactly as written
The gaps between boxes are narrow (just wide enough for a short arrow), so each box is about one sixth of the frame width
prohibitions: NO numbers, step badges or the word 'stage' or 'step' inside any box
NO text at the top of the boxes; the upper half holds only the icon
NO 'self-' at the end of one line with 'grant' on the next
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is semibold near-black #1F2328
NO person, face, head-and-shoulders avatar or ID photo inside any icon
NO quotation marks or apostrophes around the title or any label

alt_text: Step 3: the order the skill requires. Six boxes joined by arrows: flip to Agent Identity; grant query + read; show one real read (a gray box, a check rather than a change); new login, one role; point promo at it; remove admin last. An amber band reads: Each change: say, do, re-read, record undo. A red band reads: No self-grant, even after a refusal.
